Sending a game back

You do not need to email anyone to start this. Three taps, from this page, and a person picks it up the same day.

The short version

14 days from the day it arrives. Box opened or not. If the game arrived damaged or we sent the wrong one, we pay the return shipping and you do not argue with us about it.

How to do it

  1. Tap the button below and give us your order number — it is in your confirmation email, and it looks like BOR-10042.
  2. Pick a reason from the list. That is the whole form.
  3. We reply with a collection time. You do not pay anything up front.
Start a return

Rather talk to a person? Message us — a human answers, same day.

The reasons we track

Every return gets one code. The code is what tells us whether the problem is the courier, the supplier or us.

  • damagedIt arrived broken, crushed or wet.
  • wrong_itemNot the game on the order.
  • missing_partsComponents missing from the box.
  • lateIt arrived after the date we promised.
  • not_for_usIt does not suit the group. No explanation needed.
  • otherTell us in one line.
Pending, and tracked: the exact wording and the refund timing come from Ops on BOR-14, and the standing refund authority per reason code comes from BOR-27. The reason codes above are the field values the storefront will submit — if Ops renames one, it is renamed here on the same day.
